cohort: 19,121 women undergoing caesarean section between January 1, 2008 and December 31, 2016 at a tertiary referral hospital
finding: Opioid analgesia in labor was significantly associated with an increased risk of ACPO after caesarean section, while a trend towards increased risk was observed with increased estimated blood loss.
mod_finding: This study found that opioid analgesia in labor was a risk factor for developing acute colonic pseudo-obstruction after cesarean section.
